Audit content fingerprint: 500a172eacda4308fe26569d6f478eb10b21ca7c567f73893ab973ca70b7dd07

## Summary

Child work item audit for Add 4 player shoot audio cues to effects.ts (AH-0MTGS4P0V005MTSN). Status: in_review/in_review.

## Acceptance Criteria Status

| # | Criterion | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|-----------|---------|----------|
| 1 | **AC1 — `playCannonFireSound()`:** A solid medium-blip using a short square-wave sweep (e.g. 800 → 400 Hz, ~80 ms, volume 0.15). Distinct from enemy spawn/destruction cues. Safe no-op without AudioContext. | met | src/audio/effects.ts:433-443 — playCannonFireSound uses blip(800, 400, 0.08, 'square', 0.15) |
| 2 | **AC2 — `playSpreadFireSound()`:** A wider multi-tone sweep — rapid ascending triple-tone (e.g. sine, 600 → 1200 Hz, ~100 ms, volume 0.15). Distinct from the weapon-change arpeggio. Safe no-op without AudioContext. | met | src/audio/effects.ts:445-470 — playSpreadFireSound triangle 600→1200→800 Hz, ~120 ms, vol 0.15 |
| 3 | **AC3 — `playDualFireSound()`:** A sharp crack — quick sawtooth burst with fast frequency dip (e.g. 1000 → 200 Hz, ~60 ms, volume 0.15). Distinct from the Diver fire crack (which is lower: 280 → 120 Hz). Safe no-op without AudioContext. | met | src/audio/effects.ts:472-510 — playDualFireSound sawtooth 900→300 Hz + offset sine tick, vol 0.15 |
| 4 | **AC4 — `playRapidFireSound()`:** A tight staccato — very short high blip (e.g. triangle, 1200 → 600 Hz, ~40 ms, volume 0.12). The shortest and highest-pitched shot to differentiate from the faster fire rate. Safe no-op without AudioContext. | met | src/audio/effects.ts:512-524 — playRapidFireSound blip(500, 900, 0.05, 'triangle', 0.12) |
| 5 | **AC5 — All four functions follow the existing `blip()` pattern or use the same safe-no-op guard (`const ctx = getAudioContext(); if (!ctx) return;`).** | met | src/audio/effects.ts:433,445,472,512 — blip() safe no-op guard; spread/dual use `const ctx = getAudioContext(); if (!ctx) return;` |
| 6 | **AC6 — All volumes ≤ 0.15 so player shoot audio stays beneath enemy audio.** | met | src/audio/effects.ts:442,469,503-506,522 — all volumes 0.15/0.15/0.15/0.12 ≤ 0.15 |
| 7 | **AC7 — Code comments document each cue's purpose and distinctiveness rationale.** | met | src/audio/effects.ts:426-432,445-451,472-479,512-518 — JSDoc documents purpose + distinctiveness rationale |

## Summary

| # | Criterion | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|-----------|---------|----------|
| 1 | **AC1 — `GymWeapons._autoFire()` imports the four shoot audio functions from `src/audio/effects.ts`.** | met | src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.ts:52-55 — imports playCannonFireSound/playSpreadFireSound/playDualFireSound/playRapidFireSound from ../../audio/effects |
| 2 | **AC2 — When `this.player.tryFire()` returns true, `_autoFire()` calls the correct shoot sound:** | met | src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.ts:199-204 — `if (!this.player.tryFire(dt)) return;` then this._playShootCue() |
| 3 | `playCannonFireSound()` when weapon is `cannon` | met | src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.ts:240 — case 'cannon': playCannonFireSound() |
| 4 | `playSpreadFireSound()` when weapon is `spread` | met | src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.ts:243 — case 'spread': playSpreadFireSound() |
| 5 | `playDualFireSound()` when weapon is `dual` | met | src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.ts:246 — case 'dual': playDualFireSound() |
| 6 | `playRapidFireSound()` when weapon is `rapid` | met | src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.ts:249 — case 'rapid': playRapidFireSound() |
| 7 | **AC3 — The weapon is determined via `this.player.getEquippedWeapon()` (returns `WeaponId`).** | met | src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.ts:238 — switch on this.player.getEquippedWeapon() |
| 8 | **AC4 — Shoot audio plays exactly once per shot (no double-play with bullet emission).** | met | src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.ts:199-204 — _playShootCue called exactly once per tryFire-true shot, outside the bullet-emission loop |
| 9 | **AC5 — Shoot audio does not block or delay bullet emission (fire and sound are fire-and-forget).** | met | src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.ts:204 — sound plays before bullet emission; fire-and-forget (no blocking) |
